title: I Played the Frog Song
overview: It’s another idyllic day in the countryside, but things are anything but ordinary when Renge meets Akane, a flutist who has trouble playing in front of other people.

title: Hotaru Was Really Mature?
overview: Sometimes it’s hard to believe Hotaru is still in elementary school! But even Hotaru needs to act like a kid now and then… or at least that’s what Konomi thinks.

title: We Were Always Like This
overview: After breaking a bonsai planter with a Surefire Kill Shot, Natsumi and Hikage practice the art of apology… sort of. Turns out neither one of them is very good at it.

title: I Turned Into Santa to Deliver Tomatoes
overview: Ren pays Candy Store a visit to spend her New Year’s allowance, but her purchase puts Candy Store in an awkward position — one Natsumi finds absolutely HILARIOUS.

title: I Made Something Incredible
overview: Beep boop! Koma-plushie is live, boop beep! But Hotaru isn’t a master of robotics just yet, and her pet project still has a long way to go before it’s ready to fly.

title: We All Went Camping Together
overview: It’s time to go camping! Ren’s heart and mind are prepared, but a nighttime stroll through the woods will put her willpower to the test.

title: It Was a Thrilling Autumn
overview: Parents’ Day provides Natsumi a particular variety of anxiety, but she finds a way to relax when Renge brings home a new friend.

title: My Senpai Had Entrance Exams Coming Up
overview: Akane and Konomi go shopping, and they take a detour to play some festival games! But beginner’s luck will only get you so far, and there’s something weighing on Akane’s mind…

title: We Made Tasty Food
overview: Komari receives an unexpected visitor. Now she’s making a weird face and can’t seem to knit properly. But don’t worry — Natsumi will cover for her. Sort of.

title: It Got Cold and Then Hot
overview: New Year’s is here, and that means New Year’s money! What will everyone spend their cash on? And is there a way to get even more? Or perhaps that’s not a good idea…

title: I Got Drunk and Remembered
overview: Once the kids are asleep, the adults get to partying! …wait, what’s that noise? Ren is awake!? Uh oh…

title: The Cherry Blossoms Bloomed Again
overview: Following a graduation ceremony, Renge and friends spend the day playing in the great outdoors. It’s days like these you wish would never end…
